installation_params._comment_nfs_install: If nfs_install is True, rccl-tests and rccl library (optional) will be installed in NFS. Otherwise, all nodes will have local installation
installation_params._comment_rccl_lib_install: Set True to sparse-clone projects/rccl from rocm-systems and build RCCL for rccl-tests (e.g. when bundled ROCm RCCL mismatches rccl-tests). rccl-tests then builds with CUSTOM_RCCL_LIB.
installation_params._comment_rccl_lib_build_timeout: SSH exec timeout in seconds for RCCL library source build (cmake + make -j, default 10800).
installation_params._comment_rccl_lib_install_dir: Install/build root for RCCL source when rccl_lib_install is True. Ignored when rccl_lib_install is False (bundled ROCm lib under rocm_path/lib is used instead).
installation_params._comment_rccl_tests_install_dir: Directory for sparse/full clone of rccl-tests (rocm-systems root). Binaries: <this-dir>/projects/rccl-tests/build when using rocm-systems sparse checkout.
installation_params._comment_rccl_repository: Monorepo URL; install_rccl_tools sparse-checkouts projects/rccl and projects/rccl-tests automatically.
installation_params._comment_rccl_sparse: Optional overrides for git sparse-checkout paths. Omit or leave as-is for rocm-systems defaults.
installation_params._comment_rccl_git_tag: Git tag or branch for projects/rccl sparse checkout from rccl_repository. Recommended: therock-7.11 for ROCm 7.2.0 (validated in CVS testing). See https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-systems/blob/therock-7.11/projects/rccl/CHANGELOG.md for release notes.
installation_params._comment_rccl_tests_git_tag: Git tag or branch for projects/rccl-tests sparse checkout. Recommended: therock-7.11 for ROCm 7.2.0 (validated in CVS testing).
installation_params._comment_rocm_path: ROCm install root for HIP/ROCm builds. When rccl_lib_install is False, bundled librccl under <rocm_path>/lib is used.
installation_params._comment_rccl_tests_use_amdclang: If True, rccl-tests builds with HIPCC/CXX set to $ROCM_PATH/llvm/bin/amdclang++. If False, uses $ROCM_PATH/bin/hipcc.
installation_params._comment_ompi_install_dir: Open MPI install prefix (OMPI_PREFIX / MPI_HOME). Required for rccl-tests MPI build.

mpi_params._comment_mpi_pml: MPI Point-to-Point Messaging Layer: 'auto' (auto-detect UCX support), 'ucx' (force UCX), or 'ob1' (force OpenIB/TCP fallback). This remains in config because it is an MPI launch option, not an env-script setting.

rccl._comment_env_script: Shell script sourced on cluster nodes before mpirun (templates: input/env_file/rccl/). Use for RCCL/NCCL/UCX tuning. For a custom RCCL build (see installation_params.rccl_lib_install / rccl_lib_install_dir), set RCCL_HOME to that install prefix and prepend RCCL_HOME/lib to LD_LIBRARY_PATH so librccl.so is loaded instead of the system ROCm copy. mpi_dir and rccl_tests_dir are in mpi_params and rccl_test_params.

rccl_test_params._comment_rccl_tests_dir: Directory containing built rccl-tests perf binaries (e.g. all_reduce_perf). Used by rccl_perf and rccl_regression. Must match the install build output: <rccl_tests_install_dir>/projects/rccl-tests/build when using rocm-systems sparse checkout via install_rccl_tools.
rccl_test_params._comment_rccl_test_flags: Optional rccl-tests binary flags. rccl_timeout = rccl-tests internal timer passed as -T (seconds; omit to not set). output_algo_proto_channels = boolean toggle for rccl-tests' -A 1 algorithm/protocol/channels diagnostic output.

rccl._comment_cvs_params: The rccl_result_file.json will be appended by rccl_test_params.data_types. When it's float the file name will be rccl_result_file_float.json on the head node.

cvs_params._comment_cvs_exec_timeout: Optional. CVS-side outer cap on the SSH-exec call wrapping mpirun (seconds, default 2400).
cvs_params._comment_pairwise_min_bw: Minimum bus BW in GB/s required for Phase 2 incremental admission (Phase 1 pairwise never gates on bandwidth, matching the original bash tool). Set to 0 to skip the BW check.
cvs_params._comment_pairwise_results_file: Local JSON file where rccl_pairwise.py persists the Phase 1 pass/fail lists and the Phase 2 final valid/excluded host lists.

rccl._comment_regression: New regression object format using NCCL_* environment variable names. Creates Cartesian product of all combinations. Channel config uses 'min-max' format (e.g., '16-16') or 'default'. Tree algorithm is automatically filtered to only run with all_reduce_perf collective.
rccl._comments_results: expected results below are for 2 node cluster, will vary based on cluster size
